note: Sibling to 2025-bowman-baseball.csv in this same package. Covers the bowman-chrome product's own numbering, including its own Bowman Chrome Prospects insert range BCP-153 through BCP-252 (100 cards) plus the flagship 100-card Base Chrome set (#1-100). Does NOT include BCP-1 through BCP-152, which is the paper-Bowman product's own insert and is staged in the sibling file, per productSetKeys.ts treating bowman and bowman-chrome as parent/child but DISTINCT registered keys -- never folded across.
beckettCardListOnly: Card list only, no print-run column; stages the plain-Base row at every cardNumber for a fold/diff check against whatever the catalog already carries.
scopeTrimmedToCategoryBase: The raw conversion (1,452 rows) included auto-*/insert-* sections (autographs, Anime, Bowman Ascensions, etc.) needing their own registration/fold decisions -- out of scope for this pass, dropped to keep this package to the plain-Base/BCP-base acquisition target only.
masterSheetDuplicateRemoved: This xlsx has a 'Topps Master Checklist' sheet that duplicates rows already captured under their properly-cased section (e.g. 'BASE CARDS' duplicating 'Base>Base Set', 'CARDS CHROME ROOKIE RED RC VARIATION' duplicating 'Rookie Red RC Variation'). convertBeckettChecklistXlsx.cjs's SUPERSET_SHEET regex (`^(master\b|...)`) only matches a sheet name STARTING WITH 'master' and does not match 'Topps Master Checklist' (master mid-string) -- a narrow converter defect, not fixed here (would need its own PR + test per repo doctrine, out of scope for a data-acquisition pass). Worked around locally in this package only: post-conversion, rows whose parallel column is entirely uppercase (the Master sheet's own ALL-CAPS section-header artifact: BASE CARDS / CARDS CHROME ROOKIE RED RC VARIATION / INTERNATIONAL REFRACTOR VARIATION / ROOKIE COLOR RUN VARIATION / ROOKIE SHORT PRINT IMAGE VARIATION) were dropped as confirmed duplicates of a properly-cased row at the same cardNumber+player. This filter is local to this CSV; convertBeckettChecklistXlsx.cjs itself is unchanged.
plannerVerdict: PASS -- planStagedDirectory (ingest-checklist-csv-to-catalog.cjs, run read-only against this file): 355 batch rows, 355 distinct ids, 0 collisions, 0 duplicatesFolded, 0 unregistered keys.
